long_biography.plain_text:
In a Surfside apartment designed by Shelly Justice, colours from the artwork recur throughout the rooms. Her Bespoke Design & Decor practice combines furnishings from different periods, including a midcentury bronze bird sculpture and a 1970s coffee table. The guest bedroom has a blue agate floor made in Italy. Self-taught as a designer, she divides her time between Atlanta and Miami.

Justice had previously spent 15 years working as trade-show talent. At an Atlanta event, she and fellow model Danielle Chevalier wanted to understand the products they were promoting. When they ran CMT together, product knowledge became central to the agency’s approach, enabling its models to answer visitors’ questions and support clients’ sales teams.
